notes: Adds reliable keyboard Done handling and explicit keyboard dismissal for every Speedtest+ controls action while retaining the original blue-leading, gray-following gauge animation, all profiles/themes/results features, and the full finite non-negative custom-speed range.

ios.notes: Restores the compact S+ i button placement from the first working 0.1.0 build, anchored 70 points above the iOS safe-area bottom. Provider-row long-press remains available as a hidden fallback, normal server selection is untouched, and native setup/permission handling stays protected. This IPA is unsigned and must be signed before sideloading.
